notes.title: 1.0 SOON - BIG UPDATE BEFORE
notes.content: [h1]Hi! It's been a while since there's been an update for various reasons in my personal life, but I've been working hard, and here's what you'll find in this update![/h1][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]-[b]ALL[/b] THE SLIMES AVAILABLE, there are [b]116[/b] of them, including [b]8[/b] secrets that are obtained differently[/p][p][/p][p]-[b]30 Success[/b]! (one of which requires a madman to complete)[/p][p][/p][p]-[b]CHILL mode[/b], with no timer and no score (secret slime achievements and score achievements cannot be achieved with it)[/p][p][/p][p]-[b]Shinys[/b]! [b]ALL[/b] slimes have a shiny version (yes, even the secret ones).[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]Despite a lot of complications, I've finally managed to release a maj, and I hope you'll like it![/p][p]I've still got a few things to add before I can consider the game a 1.0, but we're really very close.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks a lot![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45010528/f2cb07db6bed32c9760a8af6b368d01714c66df1.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Regular Update
notes.content:
Well, we've got some new slimes.

-9 new Slimes, including the final evolutions of the 3 starters (water, fire, plant)
-A BIG FIX because I'd forgotten a lot of the slimes that give spawn scores
-And some minor fixes

And there you have it

Among the slimes that have been added 6 of them are made in reference to certain people, but also to French manga characters, I hope you'll have fun finding them :) 

Have a nice day.


Don't hesitate to join the discord! 

https://discord.gg/adt4bp73gS

notes.title: HALLOWEEN UPDATE
notes.content:
-11 new slimes, including 1 secret, all with a Halloween theme
-1 new shiny slime! 
You can save in the in-game options to come back later! 

Have fun!

notes.title: FIX + FIRST SHINY
notes.content:
Fix: 
-Text that should have been displayed in French was displayed in English 
Double-click to validate the end of the game instead of a single click (avoids mistaken clicks).
-Slime souls reset to 0 at the start of the game.


Added:
-The first shiny slime! This is the basic one, with a 0.1% chance of getting it every time you create one. 
-It can merge with other basic slimes, but won't give a shiny.
-Once unlocked, click on the basic slime in the slimedex to display it instead.
